name: value-pill
title: Value Pill
summary: A plain value, such as a date or an amount, set off in text.
description: Inline value badge: a plain value (a date, a name, a count) set off in prose. Softer than a status pill (no dot) and not a mono token. Stays on one line while it fits; a value longer than its container wraps inside the pill and is never truncated. The value reads in its own direction (unicode-bidi: plaintext): a signed number stays "-4.41%" on a right-to-left page.

notes: Plain text in a span; tone is decoration.
unicode-bidi: plaintext on the pill: a value with no strong direction (a signed number, a date) is laid out left to right on either page, and a right-to-left value right to left.
